widgets.name: Box
widgets.doc: A layout composable with [content].

widgets.name: Box
widgets.doc: A box with no content that can participate in layout, drawing, pointer input due to the [modifier] applied to it.

widgets.name: Row
widgets.doc: A layout composable that places its children in a horizontal sequence.

widgets.name: Column
widgets.doc: A layout composable that places its children in a vertical sequence.

widgets.name: Spacer
widgets.doc: Component that represents an empty space layout, whose size can be defined using [Modifier.width], [Modifier.height] and [Modifier.size] modifiers.

widgets.name: FlowRow
widgets.doc: [FlowRow] is a layout that fills items from left to right (ltr) in LTR layouts or right to left (rtl) in RTL layouts and when it runs out of space, moves to the next "row" or "line" positioned on the bottom, and then continues filling items until the items run out.

widgets.name: Text
widgets.doc: High level element that displays text and provides semantics / accessibility information.

widgets.name: Icon
widgets.doc: A Material Design icon component that draws [imageVector] using [tint], with a default value of [LocalContentColor].

widgets.name: AsyncImage
widgets.doc: A composable that executes an [ImageRequest] asynchronously and renders the result.

widgets.name: AsyncImage
widgets.doc: A composable that executes an [ImageRequest] asynchronously and renders the result.

widgets.name: Image
widgets.doc: Creates a composable that lays out and draws a given [Painter].

widgets.name: Image
widgets.doc: A composable that lays out and draws a given [ImageVector].

widgets.name: LazyColumn
widgets.doc: The vertically scrolling list that only composes and lays out the currently visible items.

widgets.name: LazyRow
widgets.doc: The horizontally scrolling list that only composes and lays out the currently visible items.

widgets.name: Icon
widgets.doc: A Material Design icon component that draws [painter] using [tint], with a default value of [LocalContentColor].

widgets.name: Surface

widgets.name: Card
widgets.doc: [Material Design filled card](https://m3.material.io/components/cards/overview) Cards contain contain content and actions that relate information about a subject.

widgets.name: Card
widgets.doc: [Material Design filled card](https://m3.material.io/components/cards/overview) Cards contain contain content and actions that relate information about a subject.

widgets.name: Button
widgets.doc: [Material Design button](https://m3.material.io/components/buttons/overview) Buttons help people initiate actions, from sending an email, to sharing a document, to liking a post.

widgets.name: TextButton
widgets.doc: [Material Design text button](https://m3.material.io/components/buttons/overview) Buttons help people initiate actions, from sending an email, to sharing a document, to liking a post.

widgets.name: OutlinedButton
widgets.doc: [Material Design outlined button](https://m3.material.io/components/buttons/overview) Buttons help people initiate actions, from sending an email, to sharing a document, to liking a post.

widgets.name: IconButton
widgets.doc: [Material Design standard icon button](https://m3.material.io/components/icon-button/overview) Icon buttons help people take supplementary actions with a single tap.

widgets.name: HorizontalDivider
widgets.doc: [Material Design divider](https://m3.material.io/components/divider/overview) A divider is a thin line that groups content in lists and layouts.

widgets.name: TopAppBar
widgets.doc: [Material Design small top app bar](https://m3.material.io/components/top-app-bar/overview) Top app bars display information and actions at the top of a screen.

widgets.name: AnimatedVisibility
widgets.doc: [AnimatedVisibility] composable animates the appearance and disappearance of its content, as [visible] value changes.

widgets.name: AnimatedVisibility
widgets.doc: [ColumnScope.AnimatedVisibility] composable animates the appearance and disappearance of its content when the [AnimatedVisibility] is in a [Column].

widgets.name: AnimatedVisibility
widgets.doc: [RowScope.AnimatedVisibility] composable animates the appearance and disappearance of its content when the [AnimatedVisibility] is in a [Row].

modifiers.name: padding
modifiers.doc: Apply [all] dp of additional space along each edge of the content, left, top, right and bottom.

modifiers.name: padding
modifiers.doc: Apply [horizontal] dp space along the left and right edges of the content, and [vertical] dp space along the top and bottom edges.

modifiers.name: padding
modifiers.doc: Apply additional space along each edge of the content in [Dp]: [start], [top], [end] and [bottom].

modifiers.name: padding
modifiers.doc: Apply [PaddingValues] to the component as additional space along each edge of the content's left, top, right and bottom.

modifiers.name: size
modifiers.doc: Declare the preferred size of the content to be exactly [size]dp square.

modifiers.name: size
modifiers.doc: Declare the preferred size of the content to be exactly [width]dp by [height]dp.

modifiers.name: width
modifiers.doc: Declare the preferred width of the content to be exactly [width]dp.

modifiers.name: height
modifiers.doc: Declare the preferred height of the content to be exactly [height]dp.

modifiers.name: fillMaxWidth
modifiers.doc: Have the content fill (possibly only partially) the [Constraints.maxWidth] of the incoming measurement constraints, by setting the [minimum width][Constraints.minWidth] and the [maximum width][Constraints.maxWidth] to be equal to the [maximum width][Constraints.maxWidth] multiplied by [fraction].

modifiers.name: fillMaxHeight
modifiers.doc: Have the content fill (possibly only partially) the [Constraints.maxHeight] of the incoming measurement constraints, by setting the [minimum height][Constraints.minHeight] and the [maximum height][Constraints.maxHeight] to be equal to the [maximum height][Constraints.maxHeight] multiplied by [fraction].

modifiers.name: fillMaxSize
modifiers.doc: Have the content fill (possibly only partially) the [Constraints.maxWidth] and [Constraints.maxHeight] of the incoming measurement constraints, by setting the [minimum width][Constraints.minWidth] and the [maximum width][Constraints.maxWidth] to be equal to the [maximum width][Constraints.maxWidth] multiplied by [fraction], as well as the [minimum height][Constraints.minHeight] and the [maximum height][Constraints.minHeight] to be equal to the [maximum height][Constraints.maxHeight] multiplied by [fraction].

modifiers.name: weight
modifiers.doc: Size the element's width proportional to its [weight] relative to other weighted sibling elements in the [Row].

modifiers.name: align
modifiers.doc: Align the element vertically within the [Row].

modifiers.name: weight
modifiers.doc: Size the element's height proportional to its [weight] relative to other weighted sibling elements in the [Column].

modifiers.name: align
modifiers.doc: Align the element horizontally within the [Column].

modifiers.name: align
modifiers.doc: Pull the content element to a specific [Alignment] within the [Box].

modifiers.name: matchParentSize
modifiers.doc: Size the element to match the size of the [Box] after all other content elements have been measured.

modifiers.name: background
modifiers.doc: Draws [shape] with a solid [color] behind the content.

modifiers.name: border
modifiers.doc: Modify element to add border with appearance specified with a [width], a [color] and a [shape] and clip it.

modifiers.name: border
modifiers.doc: Modify element to add border with appearance specified with a [border] and a [shape] and clip it.

modifiers.name: clickable
modifiers.doc: Configure component to receive clicks via input or accessibility "click" event.

modifiers.name: horizontalScroll
modifiers.doc: Modify element to allow to scroll horizontally when width of the content is bigger than max constraints allow.

modifiers.name: verticalScroll
modifiers.doc: Modify element to allow to scroll vertically when height of the content is bigger than max constraints allow.

modifiers.name: clip
modifiers.doc: Clip the content to [shape].

modifiers.name: alpha
modifiers.doc: Draw content with modified alpha that may be less than 1.

modifiers.name: shadow
modifiers.doc: Creates a [graphicsLayer] that draws a shadow.

modifiers.name: fillParentMaxSize
modifiers.doc: Have the content fill the [Constraints.maxWidth] and [Constraints.maxHeight] of the parent measurement constraints by setting the [minimum width][Constraints.minWidth] to be equal to the [maximum width][Constraints.maxWidth] multiplied by [fraction] and the [minimum height][Constraints.minHeight] to be equal to the [maximum height][Constraints.maxHeight] multiplied by [fraction].

modifiers.name: fillParentMaxWidth
modifiers.doc: Have the content fill the [Constraints.maxWidth] of the parent measurement constraints by setting the [minimum width][Constraints.minWidth] to be equal to the [maximum width][Constraints.maxWidth] multiplied by [fraction].

modifiers.name: fillParentMaxHeight
modifiers.doc: Have the content fill the [Constraints.maxHeight] of the incoming measurement constraints by setting the [minimum height][Constraints.minHeight] to be equal to the [maximum height][Constraints.maxHeight] multiplied by [fraction].

modifiers.name: animateItem
modifiers.doc: This modifier animates the item appearance (fade in), disappearance (fade out) and placement changes (such as an item reordering).

modifiers.name: offset
modifiers.doc: Offset the content by ([x] dp, [y] dp).

modifiers.name: rotate
modifiers.doc: Sets the degrees the view is rotated around the center of the composable.

modifiers.name: scale
modifiers.doc: Scale the contents of both the horizontal and vertical axis uniformly by the same scale factor.

modifiers.name: animateContentSize
modifiers.doc: This modifier animates its own size when its child modifier (or the child composable if it is already at the tail of the chain) changes size.

modifiers.name: animateContentSize
modifiers.doc: This modifier animates its own size when its child modifier (or the child composable if it is already at the tail of the chain) changes size.
